test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ______ taxes are levied by the State Government in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Excise duty on liquor.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Excise duty is a form of indirect tax that is levied by the Central Government of India for the production, sale, or license of certain goods.
 
• Excise duty charges are also collected by state governments for alcohol and narcotics.
 
• It has been replaced by the **Goods and Services Tax(GST) f**rom **1 July 2017.**
 
• The customer does not pay excise duty directly to the authorities.
 
• It is added to the cost of the product by the producer or merchant and then passed on to the consumer by way of increased prices.
 
• The **Excise Duty Act, 1944** governs the regulations related to excise duty in India.
 
• The tax is administered by the **Central Board of Excise and Customs. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Capital gains tax**

 
 
• Capital gains are the profit you make from selling or trading a "capital asset."
 
• A capital gains tax is a levy on the profit that an investor makes from the sale of an investment such as stock shares. 
 
 
 
• **Customs tax**
 
 
• Customs duty refers to the tax imposed on goods when they are transported across international borders. 
 
• In simple terms, it is the tax that is levied on import and export of goods. 
 
 
 
• **Corporation tax**
 
 
• Corporation tax is a direct tax imposed on the net income or profit that enterprises make from their businesses.
 
• Companies, both public and privately registered in India under the Companies Act 1956, are liable to pay corporation tax.
